figures.caption: Figure 3: Univariate parameter sensitivity: terminal patient viability (mean ± 95% CI, N=200 seeds per setting). Each panel varies one parameter while holding the others at default (α=0.01, β=0.50, λS=0.80); the middle bar in each panel corresponds to the default. Dashed line in the α panel marks ReAct viability (56.8) for reference. Accuracy remains 1.0 across all 7 configurations.

Figure 2: EMDG ablations (N=200): terminal patient viability and terminal deliberation time across controller variants. Bars show means and error bars denote ±1σ over seeds. The full triadic controller achieves the highest viability while minimizing deliberation time, illustrating the necessity of jointly pricing space, time, and enforcing an explicit stopping boundary.
